dis.text: Savra, the queen of the Golgari, declares that all the dead move to the hollow rhythm of necromancy, and at the Guildpact's Decamillennial anniversary she mixes quietmen among the Selesnyans and infects the roots of Vitu-Ghazi.
She frees the God-Zombie Svogthir and builds him a new body, but then betrays him, takes control of his body, cuts off his head, consumes his essence and mounts his skull on her staff.

Szadek snaps her neck, and Svogthir's spirit takes over her corpse and allies with Momir Vig to use Project Kraj, until Kos transfers into Savra's corpse, overpowers Svogthir and kills Momir Vig before he can control Kraj.
